release_notes:
Visual-only cartoon revision: floating storybook castle city, rounded pastel towers, balloons and birds, larger character heads, pointed Witch hat, friendly Gargoyle features, bright armor, star capes, springy landing animation, and coordinated purple/gold menus and controls. Decorative road geometry now follows hills without exposing its support mesh. Gameplay rules, controls, progression, secrets and saves are preserved.

797 unique local Godot assertions passed, along with 148 rendered GUI navigation checks, three clean automated 1.31 km runs, and 10 Android/signing pipeline tests. Final phone performance and owner visual review remain open.

The GitHub gameplay-check run for the exact compilation source also completed successfully: https://github.com/Lamont-Labs/Mystic-Run/actions/runs/41706092800
